title: Indiana leader-threat overbid discipline
description: Indiana leader-threat overbid discipline. The leader wants red, but Alpha cannot afford to bluff beyond survival cash. The hard part is resisting bid_auction when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.private_thought: Indiana Avenue would give us a second red, but we can't get a monopoly because Beta holds Illinois. Bidding 269 would leave us with only $26, forcing us to mortgage Kentucky to stay solvent, which reduces our cash flow. Preserving cash for future opportunities and avoiding near-bankruptcy is better.

breakdown.message: Chooses drop_out for this auction state.
Dropping preserves the unsafe post-bid cash reserve.
Declines the bluff when the cash leader can punish it.
Private thought mentions the auction pressure.
